corrections.claim: The Korean flag grows because convertTransform writes rotate() into path coordinates.
corrections.after: convertPathData applies rotate() to the path coordinates; docs link changed to convertPathData.
corrections.evidence: Bundled SVGO 4.1.0 on the fixture: default 816 bytes; convertTransform:false 816 bytes; convertPathData:false 581 bytes with rotate() retained. applyTransforms is a convertPathData option (node_modules/svgo/plugins/convertPathData.js:75-76).

corrections.claim: A folder can be dropped and all icons inside are optimized.
corrections.after: Many files at once; no folder recursion.
corrections.evidence: Drop handler reads e.dataTransfer.files only (SvgOptimizerTool.astro:2307); input is multiple without webkitdirectory (:523). A dropped directory is a non-SVG File and is skipped (:1930).

corrections.claim: Files that got larger can be left out of the ZIP.
corrections.after: The ZIP includes every result; keep the original where the larger result matters.
corrections.evidence: zipBtn filters only items with data != null (SvgOptimizerTool.astro:2254); no per-file selection exists.

corrections.claim: Only files over 10 MB skip the pixel comparison.
corrections.after: Files or results over 10 MB are optimized but not compared.
corrections.evidence: renderCheck skips when item.before or item.after exceeds CHECK_MAX_BYTES (SvgOptimizerTool.astro:2060); item.after is the optimized output (:1979); CHECK_MAX_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024 (:1325).

corrections.claim: Without a viewBox, CSS cannot change the size.
corrections.after: CSS can resize the box, but the drawing does not scale.
corrections.evidence: removeViewBox leaves width/height in place; the content no longer scales (node_modules/svgo/plugins/removeViewBox.js; SvgOptimizerTool.astro:108).

corrections.claim: 0-1 decimal places will be detected by the pixel comparison.
corrections.evidence: lowPrecision note is unconditional at precision <= 1 (SvgOptimizerTool.astro:1533); the verdict depends on pixels actually changing (compareImageData/verdict :1559-1579).

corrections.claim: inlineStyles and minifyStyles both move one-off classes into style attributes.
corrections.after: inlineStyles moves one-off class rules into style attributes; minifyStyles minifies style CSS and can remove rules the file does not use.
corrections.evidence: inlineStyles moves rules; minifyStyles calls csso and usage-based selector removal (node_modules/svgo/plugins/minifyStyles.js:36-42).

corrections.claim: removeScripts in 4.1.0 catches HTML inside foreignObject.
corrections.after: 4.1.0 removes event-handler attributes, srcdoc and executable URLs inside foreignObject, keeping non-executable HTML.
corrections.evidence: SVGO v4.1.0 release notes plus node_modules/svgo/plugins/removeScripts.js (foreignObjectDepth, HTML_URL_ATTRS, srcdoc).
